output.summary: parseDate gains a required zone parameter that changes how the input text is interpreted. All ten report functions are updated to pass 'UTC'. Check that no other unchanged callers exist and that 'UTC' is the right zone for every report.

groups.title: parseDate gains a zone parameter
groups.description: The signature now requires a zone, and the result depends on whether it equals 'UTC'. Check how non-UTC zones are handled and whether text that already carries an offset is affected.

groups.title: Reports pass 'UTC'
groups.description: Each of report1 to report10 makes the same one-line change to pass 'UTC'. Check that UTC is the intended zone for each report.
